title: BodySequence
description: A rendering sequence driven by pose assets instead of motion CSVs. hand_motions entries are pose motion description JSONs, not CSVs.

hand_motions.description: Paths to pose motion description JSONs (see pose_motion.json).

frames.description: How many frames to render per motion, spread evenly across the whole timeline. 2 gives the first and last frame. Overridden by --frames on the command line; when omitted the count is derived from the camera frequency instead.

hdri.description: Path to an HDR/EXR environment map for world lighting. When omitted the model's own lights are used.
